title: Suite Magnolia Combo Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: A combination of two separate homes, ideal for families traveling together. Prime Seaside location 5 minutes from beach and downtown Seaside. Great Porches, fenced yard, and more!
description_expanded: Description640 FOREST STREET - 3 Queens, 1 Full, Twin Trundle, Sleeps 9Seaside, Florida Vacation Rental | Suite Magnolia Combo – 4 Bedroom Retreat Near Beach & TownSuite Magnolia Combo is a four-bedroom vacation rental located at 640 Forest Street, offering a rare combination of space, privacy, and walkability in the heart of Seaside. Designed as two side-by-side cottages, this charming beach retreat comfortably sleeps nine guests, making it ideal for families or small groups seeking a centrally located home base. Just a five-minute walk to the beach and downtown, and only 352 yards from the Westend family pool, guests are perfectly positioned to experience everything Seaside has to offer—without ever needing to drive.Walkable 30A Location Near Beach, Dining, and ShoppingSet within one of the most sought-after communities along Scenic Highway 30A, this home places guests steps from over 40 locally loved restaurants, boutiques, and galleries. Spend your mornings biking beneath oak-lined streets, afternoons relaxing on the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, and evenings exploring Seaside’s vibrant town center. With close proximity to beach pavilions, community pools, and pedestrian-friendly pathways, the location delivers a seamless and highly desirable 30A vacation experience.Dual Cottage Layout Designed for Comfort and PrivacySuite Magnolia Combo offers a unique layout with two separate but adjacent homes, each featuring its own entrance, kitchen, and living space. This setup is ideal for families traveling together who want shared experiences while maintaining privacy. Both cottages are designed with bedrooms on the first floor and open-concept living areas upstairs, maximizing natural light and creating an airy, elevated feel throughout the home.Bright Living Spaces and Fully Equipped KitchensEach cottage features a second-floor living area filled with natural light, comfortable seating, and a television—perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchens include high-end appliances and dining tables that seat six, allowing for easy meals, entertaining, and connection. Whether preparing a quick breakfast before heading out or hosting a relaxed dinner, the layout supports effortless coastal living.Outdoor Living with Porches, Balconies, and Grilling AreasThe home welcomes guests with a spacious front porch complete with two classic porch swings—an inviting spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Covered second-floor balconies feature rocking chairs and tables for alfresco dining or quiet moments in the coastal breeze. Two charcoal grills located just off the footpath provide a convenient setup for casual cookouts, enhancing the laid-back beach lifestyle.Bedroom Layout and Sleeping Accommodations (Sleeps 9)Suite Magnolia Combo includes four bedrooms thoughtfully arranged across both cottages. Three bedrooms feature queen beds with private bathrooms, offering comfort and convenience for adult guests. The fourth bedroom includes a full bed with a twin trundle and its own private bath, making it ideal for children or flexible sleeping arrangements. This layout ensures both privacy and functionality for group stays.Amenities and Added Value for Your Seaside StayGuests enjoy two complimentary adult bikes, making it easy to explore Seaside and cruise along nearby bike paths. Additional amenities include two dedicated parking spaces and two charcoal grills for outdoor cooking. With its prime location, thoughtful layout, and classic coastal design, Suite Magnolia Combo offers a seamless blend of comfort, convenience, and elevated 30A living.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. Features:* Private Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin, the largest private residential beach along Scenic Highway 30A* Approx. 5-minute walk / 528 yards to beach access* Two full-size washers and dryers* Two outdoor grills for casual coastal cooking* Two outdoor showers, perfect after beach days* Peacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and towels* Access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness center* Welcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and four complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority* Two parking passes included; golf carts are considered vehicles—golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit* No pets permitted
